title: floor
description: One-shot fleet snapshot for the dispatcher: running sessions, every slot's worker/activity/transport/task/lock, held resource locks, and the unread inbox count - one call instead of four. Cheap (multiplexer + lockfiles only, no git/gh); use sm_slot_ls when you need reusability classification.

watch.description: redraw the snapshot on an interval until Ctrl-C (alias: --follow)

follow.description: alias for --watch (one word works across ls/ps/logs/floor)
